team.title: Meet the Girls' Unplugged Team
team.intro: Girls' Unplugged is built by girls who care about creating a space where other girls can feel seen, heard, supported, and free to grow.

members.name: Motunrayo Linda Idowu
members.bio: Motunrayo founded Girls' Unplugged to create the kind of space she believed girls could use: a place for honest conversations, friendship, growth, confidence, and fun.
responsibilities: Creating a welcoming experience for Bloomies

members.name: Community Support
members.bio: A future community support role focused on helping Bloomies feel welcomed, supported, and connected within the Circle.
responsibilities: Helping maintain a respectful community environment

members.name: Programs & Activities
members.bio: A future role focused on helping shape activities, conversations, games, sessions, and experiences that keep the Circle meaningful and engaging.

howWeWork.title: We listen.
howWeWork.description: The girls are at the centre of the Circle. We pay attention to what they are saying, asking for, experiencing, and creating.

howWeWork.title: We create together.
howWeWork.description: Girls' Unplugged is not built around one person's ideas. Community conversations, topics, activities, and experiences can grow from what Bloomies want and need.

howWeWork.title: We keep learning.
howWeWork.description: The Circle is growing too. We learn from our experiences, listen to feedback, and keep finding better ways to serve the community.

values.title: Respect
values.description: Every girl deserves to be treated with dignity and consideration.

values.title: Kindness
values.description: We choose empathy, encouragement, and care in how we show up for one another.

values.title: Creativity
values.description: We make room for new ideas, different perspectives, and girl-led ways of doing things.

values.title: Accountability
values.description: We take responsibility for how our actions affect the community.

values.title: Sisterhood
values.description: We believe girls should have spaces where they can connect and remind one another that they are not alone.

values.title: Growth
values.description: We are allowed to learn, change, make mistakes, try again, and become.

futureRoles.focus: Member experience, welcoming, check-ins, and community care.
Weekly activities, conversations, games, calls, and special initiatives.
Community updates, storytelling, social media, and communications.
Relationships with organisations, speakers, collaborators, and opportunities.
Visual storytelling, design, photography, video, and digital content.

founderNote.heading: A note from the founder
founderNote.message: I wanted to create the kind of space I knew girls could use. Not a place where we have to pretend everything is perfect, but somewhere we can talk, laugh, learn, ask questions, make friends, and grow together. Girls' Unplugged started with what I had, and I am excited about what we can keep building together.

teamInvitation.heading: Want to build with us?
teamInvitation.description: Girls' Unplugged is growing, and there will be room for more girls to bring their skills, ideas, creativity, and care to the work.
